description: Generate or regenerate ReGen Civics character illustrations (the 13 stewardship roles + any new ones added each season). Wraps the nano-banana-pro skill with the canonical solarpunk-elven-jedi style guide from docs/planning/CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_2026-04-03_CHARACTER_ART.md. Produces card portraits and full scenes that match the existing 13 in style, palette, and energy. Triggers on: "character art", "role illustration", "season character", "regenerate the [role] art", "new role artwork", "character portrait", "card portrait", "scene image for [role]", "fix the [role] illustration", "generate character", "stewardship role art", or any request to create or update an in-game character image.
